reply:
`async`/`await` runs on the main thread—it's syntactic sugar for promises, not threading. The UI freezes because the CPU-heavy work is still blocking that single thread.

Web Workers are the fix: they run in separate threads, so CPU work there doesn't block the main thread or UI. The cost of skipping this: frozen UI, unresponsive app, user thinks it crashed.

grade.note: Reply correctly concedes async/await is main-thread and endorses Web Workers for CPU-bound work, matching ground truth.
